lines.say: An A I agent's memory is its context. What if the model edited that context itself?
lines.text: An agent's memory is its context. What if the model edited it itself?

lines.say: Today a model just appends text to its context. Harnesses shrink it with fixed rules, like a length limit.
lines.text: A model appends text to its context. Harnesses shrink it with fixed rules.

flags.text: Fixed rule: length limit or every turn

lines.say: A C L M treats its context as a file. It edits that file with Bash, and edits sync to its live context.
lines.text: A CLM treats context as a file. It edits it with Bash, and edits sync to its live context.

lines.say: With no training, it scores fifty nine point four percent on BrowseComp-Plus, eleven point four percent higher, in relative terms, than the best baseline, with twenty one point five percent fewer FLOPs.
lines.text: No training: 59.4% on BrowseComp-Plus, 11.4% higher (relative) than the best baseline, with 21.5% fewer FLOPs.

lines.say: On coding tasks, it matches or beats the summary harness. TBLite, seventy three point seven against sixty seven. EdgeBench, forty four point six against forty two point three.
lines.text: TBLite: 73.7 vs 67.0. EdgeBench: 44.6 vs 42.3, with 59% fewer FLOPs.

lines.say: Emergent behaviors appeared: scoreboards to track subagents, a notes role, and reusable helper functions.
lines.text: Emergent behaviors: scoreboards, a notes role, helper functions.

items.text: A new notes role for itself

lines.say: Reinforcement learning lifts a small model from twenty eight point eight to forty two point five percent on BrowseComp-Plus.
lines.text: RL lifts a small model from 28.8% to 42.5%.

lines.say: On a twenty four hour task, six agents got sixty five percent more speedup at the same spend. Suffix cache reuse cuts compute thirty five percent.
lines.text: 24 hours, 6 agents: 65% more speedup at the same spend. Suffix cache reuse cuts compute 35%.

lines.say: One caution. If a model can edit its context, a prompt injection can persist there too. And these savings are FLOP counts, not measured time.
